name: Easement Restoration and Stewardship (wetland and floodplain easements)
summary: Multi-year US federal awards for organisations that design and carry out restoration, repair, maintenance and monitoring on wetland and floodplain conservation easements held by NRCS, working with its staff and the landowners.

geography.label: United States, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands and the Pacific Islands Area

reporting: Awardees give NRCS a monthly status report on work in progress, plus the project documents its standards and the agreement require.

deadline.text: Submit via Grants.gov by 11:59 pm Eastern Time on November 19, 2026.

status.quote: Application deadline: Submit via Grants.gov by 11:59 pm Eastern Time on November 19, 2026.

deadline.quote: Application deadline: Submit via Grants.gov by 11:59 pm Eastern Time on November 19, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: The following entity types are eligible to apply a. City or township governments b. County governments c. For profit organizations other than small businesses d. Native American tribal governments (Federally recognized) e. Native American tribal organizations (other than Federally recognized tribal governments) f. Nonprofits having a 501(c)(3) status with the IRS

geography.quote: Proposed projects are anticipated within all 50 states, The Caribbean Area (Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands), and the Pacific Islands Area (Guam, American Samoa, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands).

access.quote: An applicant organization may submit more than one application for different projects or propose different approaches.

window.quote: Applications must be received by Grants.gov by 11:59.59 pm Eastern Time (ET) on the established due date

amount.quote: The agency expects the amount of each award to range from $250,000 to $5,000,000.

co_finance_required.quote: There is no cost sharing requirement for this opportunity.

reporting.quote: The awardee will also provide NRCS monthly status report of work in progress
